landing.howItWorksTitle: Create a prediction market alert in minutes
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: No YAML, JSON, or code. Pick a market, set a threshold, and choose where the alert should go.
landing.step1Body: Choose a Kalshi or Polymarket event, select an outcome, and set the price threshold you want to monitor.
landing.step2Body: Chain Discord, email, SMS, webhooks, Telegram, and Slack alerts. Use template variables to include live market data.
landing.step3Body: Enable your workflow. MarketPing monitors prices continuously and alerts you when the configured threshold is crossed.
landing.ctaSectionSubtitle: Start free with two monitored markets. Upgrade to Pro for scale and every delivery channel.
